name: Sentinel

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Intimidate: Blok şansını artırır, blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Dövüş uzadıkça analiz yükü kazanır (zırh + %57,6 kritik direnci); 100 yükte özel saldırılar %30 daha az güce mal olur; %20 canda 3,5sn süren 3 zırh bonusu kazanır, süresi dolarsa max gücünün %89'unu kazanır; E3 kullanırsa canının tamamını yeniler (2. can). İkincil hasar efektleri (şok, yakma, güçlü iğne, degeneration, rupture) şart; kritik direncini sıfırlayan (fragmentation) efektler büyük avantaj. Güç kontrolü (petrify, çalma, çekme) de faydalı. E2 yakma uygulayabildiği için onu E1'de tutmak tavsiye edilir.
signatureAbility:
Secondary Iso Battery
Personal Debuffs other than Intimidate gain [20 - 40]% duration.
Once per fight when dropping below 20% Max Health, Sentinel activates 3 Armor Up Buffs granting +[2,750] Armor Rating for 3.5 seconds, expiring one at a time.
Each time one of these Armor Up Buffs ends for any reason other than being removed, Sentinel Passively gains 90% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Sentinel bots are Immune to Poison, Bleed, Armor Break, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects.

abilitySections.title: Analysis Charges - Max: 100
content: Sentinel monitors the target, when they repeat the same action consecutively, Sentinel gains 6 Analysis Charges. Actions include Light Attacks, Medium Attacks, Heavy Attacks, Dashing, Dodging, and Blocking an attack. Analysis Charges stack up to 100 max.
With its code focused towards the X-Gene, Sentinel gains twice the amount of Analysis Charges while fighting Mutant Champions.
When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, if it matches their previously activated Special Attack, gain 20 Analysis Charges.
As a Defender, or in Battlegrounds, Sentinel starts each fight with 25 Analysis Charges. Amount not increased against Mutants.

abilitySections.title: Analysis Charges - Effects
content: For every 10 Analysis Charges, Sentinel gains the following:
+[271.98] Armor Rating and Critical Resistance.
+[1,075.5] Attack Rating.
Special Attacks cost 3% less Power.
The potency of incoming Instant Damaging effects from Champions is reduced by 5%.

abilitySections.title: Analysis Complete - Passive
content: At max Analysis Charges, Sentinel gains the following abilities:
Personal Debuffs can be inflicted through the Opponent's Block.
Shock, Incinerate, Heal Block, and Armor Break Debuffs gain 50% increased duration and 100% increased Ability Accuracy.
While charging a Heavy Attack, Sentinel becomes Passively Unstoppable for 1 second. If Sentinel is struck while this Unstoppable is active, it goes on cooldown for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If Analysis Charges are less than 100, inflict a non-stacking [485.29] Intimidate Debuff for 5 seconds.
The final hit inflicts a Shock Debuff, dealing [14,304.15] Energy Damage over 4 seconds. If Sentinel is at 3 Bars of Power, he consumes 30% of a Bar to inflict an additional Shock Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first hit inflicts a Heal Block Debuff for 16 seconds.
Successive hits have a 50% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [687.5] for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit inflicts an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [3,764.25] Energy Damage over 4 seconds. Each hit also has a 50% chance to inflict an additional Incinerate.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack destroys the current Sentinel bot and removes all Buffs and Debuffs that were on it. Then a spare Sentinel bot is called in to take its place, which arrives at full Health.

Spare Sentinel bots are Persistent, with only 1 available per Quest. As a Defender, regain 1 spare Sentinel at the end of the fight. While no spare Sentinel is available, this Special cannot be activated.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Secondary Iso Battery
content: Personal Debuffs other than Intimidate gain [20 - 40]% duration.
Once per fight when dropping below 20% Max Health, Sentinel activates 3 Armor Up Buffs granting +[2,750] Armor Rating for 3.5 seconds, expiring one at a time.
Each time one of these Armor Up Buffs ends for any reason other than being removed, Sentinel Passively gains 90% of a Bar of Power.
